subject: Copywriting
title: Social Proof: Reviews Rule
description: A quick, practical guide to Social Proof: Reviews Rule.

hook.text: 93% of consumers read reviews before buying. One stranger's opinion outweighs a brand's entire marketing budget.

buildup.text: Amazon built an empire on reviews. The star rating is the most-read copy on the page—and the brand didn't write it.

discovery.text: A product with 10 reviews outsells identical ones with zero, regardless of price. Social proof beats features.

twist.text: Fake reviews are a $500M industry. Amazon sues review farms. When trust in social proof breaks, sales collapse.

climax.text: Verified purchase badges, photo reviews, and video testimonials are the new arms race for authentic social proof.

punchline.text: 93% check reviews. The crowd writes the best copy.

quiz.question: What percentage of consumers read reviews before purchasing?
